l6.crc_formula: ceil(4 x expected_total / 1000) (D-s4), from the instrument's l6_schedule
l6.deadline_formula: 1.25 x records x 3600 / rate + 600 (the instrument's l6_schedule.session_timeout_s)

deadline_rate.source: the slowest archived planning rate (the last observed B1 mapping, this document's planning_rates_NOT_calibration); B2Q MEASURES the real one

clocks.wall: time.time() on the host, seconds since the epoch
clocks.resolution_s: one runner poll interval (~0.02 s): every line a poll returned shares its stamp
